items.content_html:

This also makes the options more consistent (i.e. extraOpts is similar to pruneOpts, backupOpts, etc.).

items.content_html:
The cache directory was introduced in #378228, but did what it was supposed to do.

The variable expansion inside Environment= never worked, so the cache was never used (only an empty directory was created due to CacheDirectory=).
To quote from https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.exec.html#Environment= : Variable expansion is not performed inside the strings and the "$" character has no special meaning.

items.title: nixos/restic: Rewrite module to be more flexible

items.content_html:
Description of changes

Add a privateTmp setting copied over from a similar one in the borgbackup module. This allows to disable PrivateTmp (which implies PrivateMounts), and allows e.g. mounting and unmounting snapshots in the preStart/postStop scripts. PrivateMounts is annoying in that way:

File system namespaces are set up individually for each process forked off by the service manager. Mounts established in the namespace of the process created by ExecStartPre= will hence be cleaned up automatically as soon as that process exits and will not be available to subsequent processes forked off for ExecStart=
